target_customer: HVAC equipment distributors, who give their contractor customers a digital catalog and proposal tool
problem: HVAC contractors build sales proposals slowly from paper catalogs and spreadsheets, so in-person selling is slow. Distributors have no easy way to put pricing and product data in front of contractors.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to distributors (digital pricebooks and proposal templates for their dealers); pricing not found
product_category: HVAC distributor digital pricebook and contractor proposal software

founders.name: Sam Steyer
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was CEO of Greenwork (S21) until he left in November 2023 and worked in climate tech data science.

founders.name: Gautam Jayaraman
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked on marketplaces at DoorDash. A company history page says he became CEO in November 2023.

technical_complexity.rationale: A catalog, pricing and proposal-builder web app. The hard part was ingesting distributor pricing data, which is integration work rather than research.

defensibility.rationale: Once a distributor loads its pricebook and dealers use it, switching has some friction, but the software itself was easy to copy and incumbents in HVAC pricebooks existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established from dated sources. ServiceTitan offers proposal features today per its site, but no dated evidence was found of it targeting this wedge in 2021.

market_need_then: The company pitched proposal creation as fast as e-commerce checkout, saying contractors could build one in under 10 minutes. No independent dated evidence of spend or complaints was found.

branding.domain_note: Used onsitepro.co, not a .com. No date or price found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain product language on the landing page

rebrands.why: Reason not stated in sources; the YC listing says Onsite Pro was formerly Greenwork

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand was found. The company operated under two names and the website footer still reads Greenwork Inc.

outcome_analysis: YC lists Onsite Pro as inactive, but no shutdown notice, acquisition or layoff report was found, and the company website was still live with a login and a 2026 Greenwork Inc. copyright, so the cause and even the date of any failure are not public. The company raised about 2.4 million dollars in late 2021 per one outlet and was led by Gautam Jayaraman after Sam Steyer left in November 2023. With no public cause, failure factors are left empty.
notes: The round rests on one outlet (Venture Capital Journal, which says 2.4M under the Greenwork name); CB Insights shows a 2.25M convertible note on 2021-11-23 and VCBacked lists about 2.3M total as pre-seed, so the amount is uncertain. Aggregators may mix this company with another Greenwork. One directory names a different co-founder (Jamie Finch) that no YC source supports and is not recorded. The website appears live, which conflicts with the Inactive YC status. No dated competitor source was found; Pricebook Digital and ServiceTitan exist now but their pages are undated, so the list is empty.
